tytul: Candied watermelon and melon rind: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for candied watermelon rind or candied melon rind.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to an FDA table of approximate values, watermelon has a pH of 5.2–5.8.
According to the same FDA table, cantaloupe melon has a pH of 6.17–7.13.

According to a University of Missouri Extension newsletter, candied fruit in general retains a bit of moisture, so it is kept in an airtight container in the refrigerator to prevent mold and used within a week.

akapity: JarAtlas has found no checked source for the pH of the rind of either fruit.
JarAtlas has found no checked source for candied melon rind, and no tested process for rind kept in syrup.
JarAtlas has found no checked source that says how long candied watermelon rind keeps.
